title: “Just a strange pic”: Evaluating ‘safety’ in GenAI Image safety annotation tasks from diverse annotators’ perspectives
reasoning: The paper uses Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) as a central framework for its qualitative and quantitative analysis. It specifically develops and evaluates a 'moral sentiment autorater' to classify text into moral categories (Care, Equality, Purity, etc.) and analyzes how these moral values influence annotators' safety judgments.
